blind.description: A stylized medieval/fantasy wooden display rack containing blacksmith wares. It consists of a timber frame with a backboard and lower shelf supported on four legs. Mounted along the top rail are four dark iron rings/shackles. On the vertical board hang four short swords or daggers flanking a central round shield with a brass rim and central boss. Resting on the bottom bench shelf are two steel helmets flanking a small cast-iron cauldron in the center. The back features clean wooden panelling. Textures are hand-painted stylized wood and metal.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden frame with side posts, showing four iron hoops along the top rail, the curved tops of two helmets, and a round open cauldron rim in the center between them, casting a long diagonal shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3.8 to 4 feet tall), and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
